title: proud dad again …
excerpt: Last weekend we celebrated my younger daughter’s graduation. May 14 is my older daughter Rachel’s birthday. Here’s 7/8ths of our clan (Rachel’s husband, Jesse, couldn’t be with us). Rachel’s the one my arm is around.
